subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

She was fond of walking along the path besides the lake.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**besides**" instead of the correct word "**beside**."
 
• "**Beside**" means "next to" or "at the side of," which is appropriate in this context.
 
• "**Besides**" means "in addition to," which does not fit the context.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She was fond of walking along the path **beside the lake**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "She was,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "fond of walking,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "along the path,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
